name: Premium Next.js Full-Stack E-Commerce Store
tagline: A full-stack e-commerce platform with product catalogs, customer accounts, Stripe and COD checkout, and an admin fulfillment dashboard.
description: Developed as part of an internship with Codec Technologies, this e-commerce application combines a customer storefront with an administration panel for managing products, categories, inventory, customer accounts, and order fulfillment. The project uses Next.js App Router, Prisma ORM, and MySQL, with Stripe credit-card payments and Cash on Delivery workflows.
problemStatement: An online retailer needs a complete storefront and administration system to manage product discovery, shopping carts, customer accounts, payments, stock, and order fulfillment.
solution: A Next.js full-stack e-commerce application with dynamic product catalogs, category filtering, cart and checkout workflows, customer account management, inventory controls, and an admin order-fulfillment console.

storefront: Dynamic hero banner sliders loaded from database settings
Product catalog with descriptions, comparison pricing, stock, and category badges
Shopping cart with variant selectors, quantity controls, and subtotal calculations
Checkout with address selection and payment method options
Automatic stock checks during order placement
Order history with status, pricing summaries, and itemized listings
admin: Dashboard showing sales volume, customer totals, category totals, and recent orders
Root category and nested subcategory management
Order details including customer and shipping-address snapshots
